status: DESIGN ONLY — no broker implementation exists; vectors define the acceptance oracle for Lane A integration.

oracle.rule: A vector PASSES only when expected_broker_result and expected_error_code match AND no must_not_happen condition occurs. Any must_not_happen violation is a FAIL regardless of result/error match.

fail_conditions.label: generic command execution
fail_conditions.description: Any plan input or plan field causes execution of a generic command rather than a capability-bound executable.

fail_conditions.label: shell invocation
fail_conditions.description: Any execution path routes through sh/bash/cmd/powershell with a constructed string.

fail_conditions.label: caller-selected executable
fail_conditions.description: The caller (plan/inputs/IPC) selects or influences the program path.

fail_conditions.label: caller-selected cwd
fail_conditions.description: The caller selects a working directory outside the adapter allowlist.

fail_conditions.label: parent credential inheritance
fail_conditions.description: The child inherits the parent environment wholesale, including non-allowlisted secrets.

fail_conditions.label: required_approval plan executable
fail_conditions.description: A plan with required_approval=true executes without a valid approval.

fail_conditions.label: expired/replayed plan executable
fail_conditions.description: An expired, stale, or already-consumed plan executes.

fail_conditions.label: process tree survives timeout
fail_conditions.description: Any descendant of the spawned process survives timeout/cancel/broker death.

fail_conditions.label: unbounded stdout/stderr
fail_conditions.description: Output capture is unbounded in bytes or causes broker deadlock/OOM.

fail_conditions.label: unknown JSON fields silently accepted
fail_conditions.description: Unknown or reserved JSON fields are accepted without rejection.

fail_conditions.label: .cmd/.bat/.ps1 executable accepted by default
fail_conditions.description: A script file is accepted as the plan executable.

fail_conditions.label: PATH-selected fake binary executable
fail_conditions.description: A PATH/cwd-selected binary executes instead of the pinned executable.

fail_conditions.label: output/credential full persistent logging
fail_conditions.description: Captured output or credentials are persisted fully and unredacted.

threat_registry.title: Plan state machine bypass (jump / executing replay / non-atomic transition)
Approval reference forgery or missing approval (fake reference, replay, broken binding)
Lenient deserialization (unknown JSON fields silently accepted)
Unicode / path normalization confusion (homoglyphs, fullwidth forms, case, trailing dot/space)
NUL / control character smuggling (argv, paths, env, output/display)
Pipe deadlock / never-closing output handles (inherited handle holds pipe open)
Credential-shaped output fully persisted unredacted (output/credential logging)

fixture_contract.probe_executable: The harness supplies a configurable probe executable registered as the pinned github-cli binary (gh.exe). Behaviors are selected per vector via child_behavior.
path_fixtures: planted fake gh.exe in PATH dir
fixture_contract.marker_contract: Fake binaries write a marker file on execution; PASS requires marker absence for planted binaries and marker presence for the pinned probe.
fixture_contract.race_iterations: Vectors with race_iterations must be run that many times; every iteration must pass.
